item.title: CVE-2026-132814 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.0 does not verify that a Microsoft ID token was issued for the site's own application and tenant when multi-tenant sign-in is enabled with an empty list of allowed tenants, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, with a token Microsoft issued to an application they control.

item.title: CVE-2026-134748 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. Attackers can request the front-end login path with a pagename query variable to make WordPress render hidden published pages or the full blog index.

item.title: CVE-2026-134749 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated Author-level users to crash pages by saving a non-string blockPermissionsMessage block attribute. Attackers can store a JSON array in the attribute so wpautop() in get_block_replacement_content() throws a PHP 8 TypeError, causing fatal errors on post, home, search, and REST pages for unauthorized viewers.

item.title: CVE-2026-134750 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.

item.title: CVE-2026-134751 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-134752 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.

item.title: CVE-2026-134753 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write past the global obuf buffer. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment with a 4096-byte string, disabling base64_pton bounds checks to corrupt memory and crash dsniff.

item.title: CVE-2026-134754 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.

item.title: CVE-2026-134755 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | better-chatbot before 2.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that lets built-in tools run without user confirmation in Manual tool mode, because src/app/api/chat/route.ts keeps their execute handlers. Attackers can plant prompt-injected documents or web pages that make the HTTP request tool send conversation data to attacker-controlled URLs.

item.title: CVE-2026-134756 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked by validate.IsURL without resolved address validation. Authenticated users can abuse Git cloning, Helm retrieval, registry ping, or the GitLab proxy to reach loopback, internal, and cloud metadata addresses, probing ports and reading responses.

item.title: CVE-2026-134757 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.

item.title: CVE-2026-134758 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Wfuzz through 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious target servers to inject script by returning crafted links written unescaped into HTML reports. When the links script and html printer are used, attacker-supplied href values close the unquoted anchor tag and execute JavaScript when the operator opens the report.
